units.source_text: 众侍女曾在屏风背后窥看夕雾，都称赞道：“这样标致的相貌，这样漂亮的气派，实在是少见的。

en.t: The waiting women had once peeped at Yugiri from behind a screen, and they all praised him, saying, "Such handsome features, such graceful bearing, are truly rare.

units.source_text: 她们交头接耳，谈论纷纷。

en.t: They whispered together and talked excitedly among themselves.

units.source_text: 有一个老年侍女听见了，说道：“算了吧！

en.t: An elderly waiting woman heard them and said, "Enough of that!

units.source_text: 他虽然漂亮，总比不上他老太爷年轻时的相貌。

en.t: Beautiful though he is, he still cannot compare with the elder lord's looks when he was young.

units.source_text: 那才真是个美男子，教人看了眼睛发眩呢！”

en.t: He was the true handsome man, dazzling enough to make one's eyes swim!"

units.source_text: 朱雀院听见她们争执，说道：“他老太爷确是个异乎寻常的美男子。

en.t: Suzaku-in heard their dispute and said, "The elder lord was indeed an extraordinarily handsome man.

units.source_text: 年纪长大起来，反比年轻时更加艳丽，所谓‘光华’，大概就是这般模样吧。

en.t: As he grew older, he became even more radiant than in youth; what people call shining brilliance must have looked something like that.

units.source_text: 当他端居庙堂、策划政务之时，威风凛凛，令人望而却步。

en.t: When he sat upright at court and planned affairs of state, his commanding dignity made people shrink back in awe.

units.source_text: 但当他放任不羁、戏谑调笑之时，则又风流潇洒，令人觉得异常可亲可爱。

en.t: Yet when he let himself be free and playful, jesting and laughing, he was so elegant and easygoing that people found him wonderfully approachable and lovable.

units.source_text: 这真是世间难得的人物。

en.t: He truly was a person rarely found in this world.

units.source_text: 料想此人前世必修善积福，故能有此珍贵之美貌。

en.t: One imagines that in a former life he must have cultivated virtue and accumulated blessings, and so came to possess such precious beauty.

units.source_text: 他自幼生长宫中，先帝对他异常疼爱，悉心抚育，几乎不惜生命。

en.t: He grew up in the palace from childhood, and the late emperor cherished him unusually, raising him with the utmost care, almost as if sparing not even his own life.

units.source_text: 但他绝不因此骄纵，反而谦恭克己，二十岁还不受纳言之爵，到了二十一岁，才当参议而兼大将。

en.t: But he never became arrogant or self-indulgent because of it; instead he was humble and self-restrained, refusing the rank of nagon even at twenty, and only at twenty-one becoming a councilor while also serving as general.

units.source_text: 这夕雾却比父亲进取得早，十八岁便当了中纳言。

en.t: This Yugiri, however, advanced earlier than his father, becoming middle counselor at eighteen.

units.source_text: 可见他家声望一代高似一代。

en.t: From this one can see that his family's prestige rises higher with each generation.

units.source_text: 讲到学问与才能，夕雾实在并不亚于他父亲，甚至反而比父亲更早立身扬名，真乃一大奇才啊！”

en.t: As for learning and talent, Yugiri is truly no less than his father; indeed, he established himself and won fame even earlier than his father did. He is a remarkable prodigy!"
He praised Genji and his son to the utmost.
